post.description: Compatibility endpoint for older clients and legacy DEPOSITED rows. Deposit now auto-starts milestones; calling this route when already IN_PROGRESS is idempotent.
The assigned Expert uploads a ZIP source archive before the contract milestone deadline. Upload is rejected after the deadline or when the milestone is OVERDUE.
The assigned Expert submits the final deliverable before the contract milestone deadline. First submissions and resubmissions are rejected after the deadline or when the milestone is OVERDUE.
Context-rich alias for uploading source code. The milestone must belong to the contract.

post.summary: Deposit milestone escrow and auto-start milestone
post.description: Business deposits milestone escrow. On success, both milestone records move to IN_PROGRESS and the execution timeline starts.
Context-rich alias for final deliverable submission. The milestone must belong to the contract.
